meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里的未使用代码(导入、常量、函数、参数、整份文件),用 LSP 引用查询逐项核实后分批交给并行子代理删除,每个批次单独提交,最后跑类型检查、测试和构建。
howto.when: 当你提到 “remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup” 等关键词时触发。也可传入文件路径、目录或符号名把扫描限定在局部。

say.text: 扫描整个项目,把确认无引用的死代码删掉
say.note: 零引用才删;没找到会直接说明

say.text: 只清理 src/utils/ 目录下的死代码
say.note: 传目录或文件路径可缩小扫描范围

say.text: 清掉 src/foo.ts 里没用到的常量,参数加下划线保留
say.note: 函数签名要求的参数不删,改成 _ 前缀

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unused code (imports, constants, functions, parameters, whole files), verifies each with LSP reference lookups, then hands removals to parallel subagents in per-file batches. Every batch is committed separately, followed by typecheck, tests, and build.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup”, and similar keywords. You can also pass a file path, directory, or symbol name to narrow the scan.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project and remove dead code that has zero references
say_en.note: Zero references only; it says so if nothing is found

say_en.text: Only clean up dead code under src/utils/
say_en.note: Pass a directory or file path to limit scope

say_en.text: Clear unused constants in src/foo.ts and prefix unused params with _
